newsitem.title: FINLAND: EXTRA RAUTARUUKKI ISSUE OPTION TO BE USED.
newsitem.headline: EXTRA RAUTARUUKKI ISSUE OPTION TO BE USED.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said on Thursday the international managers of its share offering and issue would exercise their full over-allotment option to subscribe to an extra 3.8 million Rautaruukki shares.

"SBC Warburg and Union Bank of Switzerland, have announcd that they will take up in its entirety the option reserved for the managers of an extra subsription of 3.8 million shares," Rautaruukki said in a statement.
"This means that the number of shares sold by the State to institutional investors will rise to 18,860,000," Rautaruukki said, adding that the state was selling the shares on Thursday.

"Including the extra subscription, all 31.86 million of the Rautaruukki Oy shares offered to institutional investors will be sold, and all 7.4 million shares offered to the general public will also be sold," Rautaruukki said.
It repeated that the price per share was 42.00 markka.
The share issue and sale would reduce the State of Finland's stake in Rautaruukki to 42.3 percent from 68.7 percent, Rautaruukki said.
